key_points: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI.
Capable of detecting objects and unusual situations, performing analysis, and initiating actions.
Offers multiple architectural configurations: On-Premise, Edge & Cloud, and UI on Cloud with Backend on Edge.
Flexible deployment options to suit varying business needs and infrastructure.
Supports seamless integration with existing systems for enhanced functionality.
Live data recording and processing with real-time object detection capabilities.
Generates insightful reports and analysis using Generative AI for informed decision-making.
Customizable alerts enabling users to respond promptly to detected anomalies.
Collaborated with NDIL to customize Aksha for enhanced worker safety, integrating Edge + Cloud solutions.
Implemented three phases of development, including Gen AI enhancements for improved features.
Successful proof of concept on Raspberry Pi 4B, showcasing adaptability and performance.
Clients report significant reductions in human monitoring efforts and improved detection of abnormal events.
Positive feedback highlights the innovative use of CCTV technology for enhanced operational safety.
Customers express eagerness for future updates and innovations from Aksha.
Effortless scalability through microservices managed by Kubernetes, accommodating high message volumes.
Decoupled architecture enhances fault tolerance and simplifies service development and deployment.
Real-time data processing capabilities ensure timely insights and actions, maintaining high availability.
Installation requires connecting to the same network or obtaining camera RTSP links.
Compatible with any standard CCTV camera providing RTSP links, ensuring broad applicability.
Streamlined installation process enhances user experience and operational efficiency.
